data.name: Kritisha
data.gender_notes: Kritisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who critically evaluates and selects the best from various options. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'krit' meaning 'to judge'. The name Kritisha carries the meaning “Critic, judge, select” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kritisha usually hope their child will grow to embody critic, judge, select and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodies the power of discernment and wisdom.
data.etymology: Kritisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Critic, judge, select.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kritisha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kritisha symbolizes the importance of evaluation and discernment in Hindu culture. This name is often given to children who are expected to make wise decisions based on knowledge and understanding. In Hindu mythology, Kriti, an incarnation of Goddess Saraswati, embodies the power of knowledge, wisdom, and discernment. This name carries a sense of responsibility and encourages individuals to think critically and make informed choices.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kritisha represents the inner wisdom and intuition that guides us towards the right path in life. It signifies the ability to discriminate between the transient and the eternal, and between the true and the false. This name resonates with the Hindu philosophy of Viveka, or discrimination, which is considered a fundamental aspect of spiritual growth. The name Kritisha serves as a reminder to seek inner guidance and to evaluate actions based on their spiritual impact.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kritisha: Goddess of Action and Creativity. Her name signifies one who brings about change and transformation through conscious efforts and creative expression.
